component.name: Cycle
component.summary: Indoor cycling training with smart trainer control

description.p: Cycle is a GNOME application for indoor cycling training. It connects to BLE smart trainers via FTMS, lets you run structured ERG workouts, records sessions with power, heart rate, and cadence data, and provides AI coaching advice through the Claude API.

ul.li: BLE smart trainer control via FTMS (ERG mode)
Structured workout player with power zone visualisation
Session recording: power, heart rate, cadence
AI coaching suggestions powered by the Anthropic Claude API
